reported.quote: During the quarter, profit after tax stood at INR330 crores, supported by healthy performance across our Catering, Tourism, and Internet Ticketing segments.
EBITDA stood at INR386 crores, registering a year-on-year decline of 2.77%.
Our revenue from operations increased to INR1,370 crores from INR1,160 crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous year, representing a robust year-on-year growth of 18.10%.

EBITDA stood at INR386 crores with a healthy EBITDA margin of 28.17%, although there is a slight decline in the margins
Internet Ticketing revenue stood at INR361 crores, up by about 0.5%, and nearly 89% of the reserved railway tickets in India are now booked through our online platform
Catering recorded revenue of INR732 crores, achieving a robust growth of 33.82% year-on-year.
The related sector, Rail Neer, generated revenue of INR109 crores, registering a 2.83% year-on-year growth with a margin of about 10%.
Tourism delivered positive performance with revenue of INR168 crores, marking an increase in revenue with 13.5% year-on-year.
Despite temporary geopolitical disruptions, EBITDA margins improved to 11.31% from 8.78%, reflecting a better product mix and focused cost realization initiatives.
